row: Jaffe Chiropractic delivers effective results that help you and your family feel well and function at your highest abilities. Mallard Creek chiropractor, Dr. Glenn Jaffe enjoys working with patients of all ages and has a special focus on pregnant moms and children. Starting chiropractic care as early as possible gives your family the best chance at the healthiest future!
